assessments.name: Marketing Campaign Proposal (Individual)
assessments.description:
Students will research their brand's target
consumers, develop a persona, and propose
a new marketing approach to bring into the
group campaign.

assessments.name: Presentation
assessments.description:
Students pitch their persona-driven marketing
campaign, showcasing creative direction and
key recommendations. Feedback from the
pitch then refines the final campaign
handbook.

assessments.name: Marketing Campaign Handbook (Group)
assessments.description:
Building on individual proposals and
presentation feedback, students deliver a
comprehensive marketing campaign
handbook driven by their persona's
psychological and behavioural traits.
